title: Membership materials
slide_intent: Give related membership messages a common structure because joining, welcoming and identifying members are different communication jobs.
strategic_value: A shared W and uppercase naming can connect Whitney’s recruitment booklet, welcome material and member cards.
demonstration: Two tall printed pieces sit beside three Member cards; the left piece stacks membership verbs and the center includes an artwork.
practical_value: Compare the prominence of action words, welcome message and membership status across the three formats.
